summary: Replace Latin abbreviations with English: i.e. becomes 'in other words', e.g. 'for example', etc. 'and so on', via 'by/through', vs. 'rather than/against'.
questions: Can I use e.g. and etc. in Ansible docs?
What should I write instead of 'via'?

answer_card.title: Avoid Latin phrases
answer_card.answer_md:
- i.e. → in other words
- e.g. → for example
- etc. → and so on
- via → by / through
- vs./versus → rather than / against

Latin terms are harder for non-native readers and machine translation.
